newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines not revising economic targets.
newsitem.headline: Philippines not revising economic targets.

text.p: The Philippines does not need to revise its economic targets for the year following last week's effective devaluation of the peso, President Fidel Ramos said on Wednesday.

"We do not see as of the moment any need to revise our economic targets. We're still looking at a budgetary surplus, it's still single digit inflation, it's still a seven percent gnp growth rate for 1997," he said.
Many analysts have said inflation would rise and economic growth may dip following an about 12.5 percent slump in the peso.
